capabilities: Link configured keywords and variations automatically across notes
Suggest candidate keywords from note content with frequency counts
Pick the correct target for shared keyword text using paragraph context
Preview changes before applying them to a note or the whole vault
Maintain auto-updated Related sections between target notes that appear together
extras: Installation is via BRAT because the plugin is in the Obsidian Code Review period; README includes troubleshooting tips, donation link, and bug-reporting guidance. Despite 'AI-Powered' wording, keyword suggestions are described as local frequency analysis with no external service.
motivation: The README frames it as helping build a richly interconnected knowledge graph without repetitive manual linking, but gives no personal reason from the author.
problem: Manually wrapping recurring terms in brackets to build links and backlinks is repetitive and easy to forget across a vault.
summary: Rule-based keyword linker that automatically converts configured keywords and their variations into wiki-links across a vault, with previews, scoping, and tags.
